answer: Make every new identity earn its first voice by completing a small, peer-checked job before it can vote or move funds, like a raven proving its wings over an ocean before joining the flock. Each completed job is stamped onto a public basalt-hard ledger that cannot be rewritten, so a fake identity starts with zero history while a real one accumulates proof. An attacker must pay for a separate verified job history for every fake account, and each history takes real time and real work, so creating a thousand fakes costs a thousand times the effort of one honest agent.
